title.zh: 昼夜交替 · 地球自转
title.en: Day and night · the Earth’s rotation

description.zh: 太阳光是平行光，任何时刻只照亮地球的一半；地球绕地轴自西向东自转，每个地方轮流转进亮面和暗面，转一圈就是一天；站在转动的地面上看，太阳就像从东边升起、西边落下。
description.en: Sunlight arrives in parallel rays and lights only half the Earth at any moment; the Earth spins west to east on its axis, carrying every place through the bright half and the dark half in turn, one turn per day; seen from the turning ground, the Sun seems to rise in the east and set in the west.

aliases.en: why is there day and night
why does the sun rise in the east

aliases.zh: 一天为什么是 24 小时

label.zh: 自转给昼夜，公转加地轴倾斜给四季
label.en: Rotation gives day and night; orbit plus tilt gives seasons

reason.zh: 一天由地球绕自己的轴转一圈决定；地球同时绕太阳公转一圈是一年，再加上地轴是斜的，才有四季——两种转动别混为一谈。
reason.en: A day comes from the Earth turning once on its own axis; going once round the Sun takes a year, and that, together with the tilted axis, is what makes seasons — two different motions not to be confused.

reason.zh: 太阳总照亮地球、月球朝向它的那一半；昼夜是我们随地球转进转出那半边，月相是从地球看过去，月球亮的那一半露出了多少。
reason.en: The Sun always lights the half of the Earth, and of the Moon, that faces it; day and night is us turning into and out of that half, while a moon phase is how much of the Moon’s lit half we can see from Earth.
